prompt: Diagnose a rare duplicate-charge incident in the supplied synthetic repository. At least five hypotheses are plausible, but the primary root cause requires two conditions to interact. Do not stop at a narrative report: identify the root cause, cite evidence that rules out or limits the other hypotheses, propose the smallest safe fix, and provide a regression test. Preserve both safety properties: one payment intent must never create more than one provider charge, and a retry after a pre-charge failure must still be able to create exactly one charge. Do not redesign unrelated components. Your final answer must use exactly these ordered sections: Root cause, Evidence, Rejected hypotheses, Minimal fix, Verification tests, Residual risks. Under Minimal fix include exactly one fenced block beginning ```python file=repo/payment_worker.py containing the complete replacement file. Under Verification tests include exactly one fenced block beginning ```python file=repo/test_candidate.py containing runnable unittest code. Use only supplied files; do not browse or inspect unrelated files. Keep prose under 600 English words, excluding code.
